description: List the snapshots of a site's served files (point-in-time restore points). NO_VOLUME means the site was never deployed. Restoring a snapshot is done by the user in the VibeDeploy dashboard within the plan's restore window.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: list_snapshots

snapshots.description: Longhorn snapshot objects for the site's volume (name, created timestamp, size, etc.).

title: List snapshots for a site
